items.name: Helpdesk and Support
items.description: Our helpdesk looks after your people and their computers during business hours.
includes: Helpdesk by phone, email and chat, 8am to 6pm, Monday to Friday
Remote fixes, and on-site visits when needed
Updates and patches for Windows and macOS
Antivirus and health checks on every computer
A short report every month
items.sla: Urgent issues: we respond within 1 business hour.

items.name: After-hours Support
items.description: Adds evenings, weekends and public holidays to Helpdesk and Support.
includes: Urgent support outside business hours, 365 days a year
On-call engineer for outages
items.sla: Urgent after-hours issues: we respond within 1 hour.

items.name: Device Management
items.description: We set up, secure and track every laptop and phone through Microsoft Intune.
includes: New devices set up ready to use
Security settings applied and kept up to date
Lost or stolen devices locked and wiped

items.name: Cloud Backup
items.description: Daily backups of email, OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams.
includes: Daily backups kept for 12 months
Restores on request

items.name: Move to Microsoft 365
items.description: We move your email and files to Microsoft 365, priced per person.
includes: A plan agreed with you before anything moves
Email and files moved over a weekend
Quick-start guides and a person on site on day one

items.name: Cyber Security Uplift
items.description: A fixed-price project to bring your security settings up to a solid baseline.
includes: Security review of accounts, devices and email
Multi-factor sign-in for everyone
Fixes for what the review finds, and a plain-English report

items.name: Onboarding
items.description: Getting to know your setup and taking over from your current provider.
includes: Audit of computers, accounts and network
Documentation of how everything is set up
Handover from your current provider
